name: ThirdShotHub Sideline Glide Wide Court Shoes
description: The ThirdShotHub Sideline Glide is a court shoe for players with wider feet. It comes in standard (D), wide (2E) and extra-wide (4E) widths, with a roomy toe box that reduces pressure during lateral shuffles. A herringbone outsole grips both outdoor hard courts and indoor gym floors, and a reinforced toe drag guard protects the shoe when you lunge for low dinks.

specifications.upper_material: Engineered mesh with synthetic leather overlays

care_instructions: Brush off grit after outdoor play and wipe the upper with a damp cloth. Air-dry away from direct heat with the insoles removed; do not put them in the washer or dryer.
